doc.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03

title: Boogie woogie
summary: Albert says boogie woogie was created by piano players and his band played some.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom

blocks.x: That's an information that some piano players created on the piano.
In a different full sound with a different beat. So they named it Boogie Woogie.
Did your band play Boogie Boogie?
Well, we played some songs in that band, yes. Such as?
I mean, do you want any, did they have names? Oh, that's not good. What's happening?
Well, we had ones just called Boogie Woogie. Uh-huh.
